name: Aya Muqu
comment: Ayacucho Region. Declared cultural heritage 2003 but no archaeological dating found.

name: Ayşepınar
comment: Develi Turkey. Roman rock tombs but no specific period data in any source.

name: Belören Kalesi
comment: No English-language sources. Turkish castle of unknown date.

name: Beşkardeşler Kaya Mezarları
comment: Likely Phrygian rock tombs near Eskişehir but cannot confirm date.

name: Bhagwan Bharat's Statue
comment: Jain statue at Chandragiri Shravanabelagola. Possibly 10th century but unfinished. Religious monument not archaeological site.

name: Blaškovina Archaeological Site
comment: Cultural Heritage of Serbia since 1987 in Visibaba but no period data found.

name: Bosnian Pyramid of Love
comment: Pseudoarchaeology. Natural hill formation (flatiron). Scientific consensus: not man-made.

name: Bosnian Pyramid of the Moon
comment: Pseudoarchaeology. Natural hill formation (flatiron). Scientific consensus: not man-made.

name: Bosnian Pyramid of the Sun
comment: Pseudoarchaeology. Natural hill formation (flatiron). Scientific consensus: not man-made.

name: Carachupa
comment: Rock art petroglyphs in Amazonas Peru. No specific dating found. Could range widely.

name: Çem Kalesi
comment: Castle in Osmaniye Turkey. No specific dating found in English sources. Regional context suggests medieval.

name: Chipaw Marka
comment: Ayacucho region. No date found; could be Wari (600-1000 AD) or Inca period, insufficient evidence.

name: Cuchi Machay
comment: Cave paintings in Lima Region. No dating information available.

name: Currachjaghju
comment: Corsican archaeological site. Likely Bronze Age (~1500 BC) based on regional context but insufficient evidence.

name: Ephesus Archaeological Museum
comment: Museum (founded 1929/1964). Not an archaeological site. Consider removal or reclassification.

name: Furby
comment: Former parish near Västerås. Only church ruin remains. No archaeological site dating found.

name: GOLOGOÇ VİRANŞEHİR ŞANLIURFA TARİHİ KEMER
comment: No URL or dating information found. Viranşehir has Roman-era structures but cannot confirm.

name: Gritulu
comment: Peruvian/Corsican archaeological site. No dating information available. Wikipedia stub.

name: Hatun Misapata
comment: Ayacucho region. No dating found; could be Wari or Inca period.

name: Jinkiori
comment: Petroglyphs on monolith in Cusco region. Amazonian origin. No reliable dating available.

name: Kamennyy Gorod
comment: Natural geological formation (weathered sandstone in Perm). NOT an archaeological site.

name: Kirkdale Cave
comment: Hyena den with Pleistocene fauna (~121000 BP). No human artifacts found. Paleontological not archaeological.

name: Kukuli, Arequipa
comment: Rock paintings and tombs in Caraveli. No dating information available.

name: Kuntuyuq
comment: Rock paintings at 4433m altitude in Pasco Region. No dating information available.

name: Leptis Magna Museum
comment: Museum (~1920s). Not the ancient city itself (which was founded ~7th c. BC). Consider removal or reclassification.

name: Maria Reiche Museum
comment: Museum opened after Maria Reiche's death (1998). Not an archaeological site.

name: Mookambika Wildlife Sanctuary Kodachadri
comment: Modern wildlife sanctuary in Karnataka. NOT an archaeological site. Consider deletion.

name: Museo Campano
comment: Museum founded 1870. Not an archaeological site. Consider removal or reclassification.

name: Museum of the Royal Tombs of Aigai, Vergina
comment: Museum (opened 1993). Underlying Aigai necropolis dates from ~1100 BC but this entry is the museum building.

name: Northern Avenue Petroglyph Site
comment: Arizona petroglyphs. No specific dating; range widely 500-5000 years old. NRHP restricted location.

name: Paracas History Museum
comment: Museum displaying Paracas culture artifacts. Not an archaeological site.

name: Paradise Cave
comment: Natural geological karst cave. Tourist attraction. No archaeological significance.

name: Parque Nacional de Shorsky
comment: National park with diverse sites from Paleolithic to Middle Ages. No single period assignable.

name: Popping Stone
comment: Possible megalithic monument at Gilsland. "Almost total absence of historical sources or archaeological investigation."

name: Prebreza
comment: Village in Kosovo/Serbia area. No specific archaeological dating found despite multiple searches.

name: Rocks of Saskatchewan
comment: Natural rock formation in Cypress Hills. No confirmed archaeological period. Likely geological.

name: Singing Stones of Brittany
comment: Natural basalt geological formation. Not a man-made archaeological site.

name: Situs Megalit Tebing Tinggi
comment: Megalithic site in Jambi Indonesia. Insufficient dating information in English sources.

name: Temple of Lemminkäinen
comment: Finnish Heritage Agency says natural formation. Pseudoarchaeological claims with no scientific basis.

name: The Davidson Center
comment: Modern museum (opened 2001) in Jerusalem Archaeological Park. Not an archaeological site.

name: Waruq
comment: Archaeological site in Yarowilca/Chavinillo Huánuco. No dating information found.

name: Yonaguni Monument
comment: Highly debated. Neither Japanese nor Okinawa authorities recognize as archaeological. Likely natural geological formation.
